name: acceleration_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large directional institutional orders (FII flow, ETF rebalancing, index arb) are executed incrementally via TWAP/VWAP algos, causing the 1-minute ROC to ramp up progressively before the full move is obvious. When the 30-second change in 1-minute momentum (ROC_accel) turns positive for 15+ consecutive seconds and its own slope is rising, NIFTY is in the 'jerk phase' — the third derivative is positive, meaning algorithmic participation is actively growing. At 5-second resolution we can enter during this early acceleration window, capturing the first 6-12 option points before reactive momentum traders pile in and the acceleration peaks.
core_signal_oneliner: Positive and rising rate-of-change acceleration (third derivative of price) confirming institutional TWAP momentum buildup in the early phase of a directional move

name: adaptive_threshold_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, FII-driven directional flows create persistent RSI regimes where static 30/70 thresholds fail — during morning momentum sessions the index RSI(12) can stay above 65 for 5-10 minutes before a pullback. By calibrating overbought/oversold thresholds to the 90th/10th percentile of RSI over the past 20 minutes (240 bars), the strategy detects true regime extremes rather than absolute levels. When RSI hits the dynamic oversold threshold AND Bollinger Bands expand from a recent micro-squeeze (indicating a volatility compression release), VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that dominate NIFTY order flow are overextended and begin rebalancing, producing a 10-20 spot point mean reversion within 30-90 seconds as resting limit orders absorb the directional excess.
core_signal_oneliner: RSI at dynamic 10th/90th-percentile extreme combined with fresh Bollinger micro-squeeze release, signaling regime exhaustion and imminent mean reversion

name: adversarial_ensemble_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, simultaneous agreement across five independent microstructure signals — VWAP dislocation (short-term supply/demand imbalance), ORB directional break (institutional positioning established in the opening 20-minute window), RSI extreme (3-minute momentum exhaustion or initiation), volume spike on a directional bar (block trade or basket execution activity), and EMA trend alignment (10-minute institutional trend context) — indicates a program trade, FII basket order, or multi-strategy algo convergence is in progress. At 5-second resolution, this multi-signal confluence is rare (~2-4 times per session) but highly directional: when all signals agree and none contradicts, NIFTY typically sustains the move for 15-25 spot points over the next 30-120 seconds as the underlying institutional order continues to execute. The adversarial veto eliminates entries where any sub-strategy is actively signaling the opposite direction, filtering out fake breakouts driven by temporary liquidity gaps in the NIFTY order book.
core_signal_oneliner: Majority agreement (3-of-5) across VWAP dislocation, ORB break, RSI extreme, volume spike, and EMA alignment, with adversarial veto if any sub-signal contradicts

name: adverse_selection_filter_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second resolution, institutional TWAP programs and FII basket orders create measurable directional volume imbalance within each bar, estimated via bulk volume classification (BVC): buy_vol = bar_vol × (close - low) / (high - low). When this imbalance is high over the past 5 minutes (VPIN above the 70th percentile of the recent 20-minute distribution), informed directional flow dominates and NIFTY price continuation over the next 30-90 seconds is likely — we buy the direction via momentum. When VPIN is low (below the 35th percentile), noise traders dominate, liquidity providers absorb the imbalance, and 2-minute RSI extremes revert within 30-60 seconds — we fade the move via mean-reversion. The dual-regime structure avoids the classic adverse-selection error of mean-reverting into an institutional order.
core_signal_oneliner: VPIN-based regime classification: momentum-follow when informed flow dominates (VPIN > 70th pctile), mean-revert RSI extremes when noise flow dominates (VPIN < 35th pctile)

name: adx_strong_trend_pullback
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional TWAP algorithms execute large directional mandates, the index forms persistent 2-4 minute micro-trends reflected in ADX(36) rising above 25. Retail momentum chasers and short-term scalpers periodically take profit, pulling NIFTY 8-15 spot points back to the 2-minute EMA — the lowest bar of the pullback touches the EMA while the close stays near it. These shallow retracements are immediately absorbed by the institutional order flow still partially unfilled: the moment NIFTY's 5-second close reclaims above the 2-min EMA (+DI > -DI confirming buy-side dominance), the next wave of institutional program buys resumes, creating a 10-20 spot point continuation within 30-90 seconds. The EMA touch-and-reclaim specifically filters for entries where selling pressure exhausted at the EMA support rather than cutting through it, maximising directional probability.
core_signal_oneliner: Price touches 2-minute EMA during ADX-confirmed strong trend then closes back above (or below) it, signaling shallow pullback exhaustion and trend continuation

name: adx_trend_strength_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP algorithms executing directional orders over a 5-minute window create sustained directional pressure visible as ADX(60) rising through 25 — the cumulative high-low ranges skew consistently in one direction as the algorithm absorbs opposing liquidity. The +DI/-DI spread widening above 8 confirms the imbalance is directional rather than choppy two-sided volatility. At 5-second resolution, we enter when ADX is STILL RISING through the 25 level, meaning the institutional order is only partially filled and the next 30-90 seconds will see continued directional pressure before the order completes. The VWAP filter ensures we trade with the session flow, not against accumulated directional drift.
core_signal_oneliner: ADX above 25 and still rising with DI spread confirming directional bias and price above/below VWAP, signaling an institutional order in progress

name: afternoon_profit_fade
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, when the index has moved more than 0.5% from session open by 14:45 IST, a predictable mean-reversion impulse emerges as leveraged retail and intraday prop-desk participants simultaneously unwind directional positions to avoid NSE EOD MTM margin calls and overnight risk. This creates concentrated one-sided order flow — heavy selling on strong up-days, aggressive covering on down-days — that pushes the index 15-25 spot points back toward session VWAP in the 14:45-15:15 window. BANKNIFTY exhibits a stronger version of this pattern given its higher retail F&O participation and leverage ratios. At 5-second bars we enter precisely as the unwinding flow begins at 14:45 rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar confirmation, capturing the first leg of the VWAP reversion.
core_signal_oneliner: Index has moved >0.5% from open by 14:45 IST and is still extended versus session VWAP, anticipating EOD position-squaring reversal toward VWAP

name: atr_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second candle's range exceeds 1.5× the recent 2-minute average true range, it signals that a large directional market order has swept multiple price levels within a single 5-second window — characteristic of institutional algo execution (TWAP/VWAP programs) that have initiated a directional leg. These programs typically fill only 30-60% of their intended size per burst, leaving continuation pressure that persists for the next 30-90 seconds. We enter at the close of the expansion candle in the direction of the bar (bullish close → CE, bearish close → PE), capturing the continuation leg before the program order is complete.
core_signal_oneliner: Single 5-second bar range exceeds 1.5x the 2-minute ATR with above-average volume, signaling institutional program order initiation

name: atr_breakout_volatility_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute ATR expands above its own 10-minute baseline (ratio > 1.2) and price breaches a 2.0 * ATR channel anchored to the session VWAP, it signals that an institutional directional order — a large TWAP execution or a triggered stop cascade — is actively overwhelming resting passive liquidity. At 5-second resolution we enter within the first 1-2 bars of the breach, before most 1-minute momentum algorithms have confirmed the move on their bar close. The VWAP-anchored channel self-adjusts to the day's realized volatility, so the breakout threshold is statistically significant regardless of whether the session is calm (ATR 8 pts) or volatile (ATR 18 pts).
core_signal_oneliner: Price breaks the VWAP ± 2×ATR channel while 5-minute ATR ratio exceeds 1.2, confirming an expanding volatility breakout aligned with trend and volume

name: atr_channel_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY closes above its 2-minute ATR-adaptive Keltner Channel (EMA_24 + 2×ATR_24) with above-average volume on a 5-second bar, passive sell-side liquidity at that level has been fully absorbed by active institutional buyers. On NIFTY, these breakouts trigger momentum-following algorithms and delta-hedging from option market makers within seconds, producing a 10-20 spot point continuation impulse in the first 30-90 seconds. The ATR-adaptive channel ensures the breakout exceeds current intraday volatility noise, distinguishing genuine institutional flow from routine price oscillation around the channel midline. Low-VIX filter (VIX < 22) excludes stress regimes where breakouts reverse violently due to gap risk.
core_signal_oneliner: Close above 2-minute ATR-adaptive Keltner Channel upper band with relative volume surge, confirmed in low-VIX regime

name: atr_expansion_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional block orders (FII routing, VWAP algo completions, ETF rebalance flows) periodically create 5-second bars with range 2.5x+ the recent 10-minute ATR baseline. These are not random volatility spikes — they represent a genuine temporary imbalance between aggressive directional order flow and resting limit orders. When this expansion bar simultaneously creates a new session high (or low), the imbalance has overwhelmed ALL existing supply (or demand) accumulated since market open, signaling that the directional order flow is large enough to shift the session's price discovery level. NIFTY's high liquidity means the index can absorb most flows without such extreme bars — so when they occur, they carry information. The VWAP alignment and volume surge (2x+ the prior 5-minute average) confirm the expansion is institutional flow rather than a fat-finger or illiquidity artifact. Entry is on the expansion bar's close, betting that the flow that created the bar has not fully executed and will continue pushing the index for the next 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-second bar range exceeds 2.5x the 10-minute ATR baseline while simultaneously making a new session high/low, with 2x volume surge and VWAP alignment

name: autocorrelation_regime_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 5-minute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of 5-second returns quantifies two competing microstructure forces simultaneously present in the index order book. Positive autocorrelation (> 0.20) signals institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing large directional mandates whose resting orders persist across dozens of 5-second bars, creating momentum that lasts 30-90 seconds; we follow the prevailing 1-minute impulse. Negative autocorrelation (< -0.20) signals short-gamma market makers delta-hedging options books dominating the tape — they reflexively fade each 5-second tick with the opposite side, so every 1-minute move becomes self-correcting; we fade back toward VWAP. The 5-second bar resolution lets us classify and react to regime transitions 12× faster than the original 1-minute formulation, entering at the regime's onset rather than after confirmation.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of returns classifies regime: positive (>0.20) triggers momentum follow, negative (<-0.20) triggers VWAP mean reversion

name: bayesian_update_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when three independent evidence streams — a 1-minute directional price push (ret_12 z-score), above-average volume confirming institutional participation (volume/avg_volume ratio), and VWAP positioning reflecting benchmark-driven flow — simultaneously point the same direction, a Bayesian running posterior accumulates per 5-second bar. When the posterior exceeds 0.68, the probability that the three-way alignment is coincidental falls below 32%, indicating that FII algorithmic buyers, domestic VWAP-benchmarked orders, and momentum algos are all aligned. NIFTY then sustains direction for another 60-90 seconds because the order flow driving each evidence stream is only partially filled and continues reinforcing the move. The posterior's 3-bar monotonic increase confirms that evidence is accumulating (new order flow arriving) rather than peaking (existing flow finishing), distinguishing a continuation from a reversal.
core_signal_oneliner: Naive Bayes posterior combining 1-minute return z-score, volume ratio, and VWAP position exceeds 0.68 with 3-bar monotonic increase

name: bb_squeeze_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute Bollinger Band width compresses below the 10th-15th percentile of the prior 1-hour distribution, systematic market-making algos narrow their quotes and momentum programs stand aside — the index is in a low-uncertainty microstructure regime with order flow evenly balanced. The breakout fires when NIFTY closes outside the compressed band on above-average volume, triggering cascading entries from rule-based trend-following algorithms and breakout systems that share similar momentum filters. On NIFTY specifically, these cascades sustain for 30-90 seconds because FII-dominated institutional flow executes in TWAP/VWAP waves, meaning the initial breakout price is only partially absorbed and each subsequent 5-second bar sees renewed directional order pressure — a directional autocorrelation window that equity names lack.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute Bollinger Band width below 15th percentile of 1-hour history followed by close outside band with 1.5x volume surge

name: bid_ask_imbalance_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when large institutional participants (FII desks, mutual fund TWAP algos) are working directional orders, each 5-second bar consistently closes near its high (buy-side pressure) or near its low (sell-side pressure) because continuous aggressive order flow absorbs the opposing side. When this bar-level imbalance sustains across a 1-minute EMA window, the institutional order is still active — large directional orders are typically only 40-60% filled at any 1-minute mark — predicting continuation of the NIFTY spot move over the next 30-90 seconds. We approximate the L2 bid-ask imbalance using OHLCV microstructure: bar_imbalance = (close - low) / (high - low) - 0.5, which captures the net buying vs selling pressure visible in each 5-second bar without requiring raw order book depth data.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute EMA of bar-level close-position imbalance ((close-low)/(high-low)-0.5) z-score exceeds ±1.5 with volume confirmation and VWAP alignment

name: bollinger_band_reversion_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY closes below its 5-minute Bollinger lower band (60-bar, 2σ), algorithmic sell programs have driven price beyond the normal micro-volatility range, exhausting near-term sell-side liquidity at that depth. Market makers net-short gamma from option selling immediately begin delta-hedging by buying NIFTY futures, and VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks see fills significantly better than their benchmark and start accumulating. This reactive buying typically pushes NIFTY back toward the 5-minute SMA within 30-90 seconds, covering 10-15 spot points of reversion. The converse holds at the upper band: overbought micro-conditions trigger gamma-hedgers selling futures and profit-taking from momentum players, producing a downward reversion to the midline.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY closes outside 5-minute Bollinger 2σ band with volume surge, triggering gamma-hedger and VWAP-benchmarked counter-flow toward midline

name: bollinger_mean_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, every intraday selloff that pushes the index beyond its 5-minute Bollinger lower band (2.5σ) represents statistical exhaustion of the selling program — stop-loss cascades and TWAP sell algos running out of residual order. At this exact bar, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers (sitting on positive tracking error vs. session VWAP) begin absorbing with limit bids, and the 5-second candle closes back above the lower band with a bullish body (close > open). At 5-second resolution we enter immediately on this reversal candle rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar, capturing the first 10-20 spot point bounce (4-6 option points) before mean-reversion algos drive price back toward the 5-minute SMA. The symmetric logic applies for upper band rejections: high-momentum buying programs exhaust residual buyers, delta-hedging from options market-makers accelerates the fade.
core_signal_oneliner: Price wick touches 5-minute Bollinger 2.5σ band then closes back inside with a confirming body (pinbar-style), indicating immediate selling/buying exhaustion

name: bollinger_price_action_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, when the index probes a 5-minute Bollinger Band extreme (±2σ around the 5-min mean) and a single 5-second bar forms a rejection pinbar — low wicking below the lower band then closing up, or high spiking above the upper band then closing down — it signals that resting institutional limit orders and market-maker delta-hedging have absorbed the directional momentum flow. At NIFTY's band extremes, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms see price 15-25 spot points offside and aggressively lift offers (at the lower band) or hit bids (at the upper band), creating the pinbar's rejection wick. In low-VIX regimes (VIX < 18) where NIFTY oscillates in a controlled range, institutions defend these band extremes rather than chase breakouts, triggering a 10-20 spot point mean reversion toward the 5-minute midband within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Single 5-second rejection pinbar at 5-minute Bollinger ±2σ extreme in low-VIX regime, showing wick penetration then body close back inside band

name: bollinger_squeeze_breakout
mechanism: On NIFTY, micro-consolidation periods lasting 1-3 minutes produce a measurable Bollinger Band width compression (2-minute rolling std at session lows) as institutional algorithms pause directional flow and resting limit orders accumulate on both sides of the range. When price breaks above the upper band on a simultaneous volume spike, net buy-side order flow has absorbed the accumulated sell-side resting orders at the squeeze ceiling. This initiates a stop-cascade above the range (stops placed by participants who shorted the squeeze boundary) and VWAP-chasing algorithms pile in, producing a 10-20 NIFTY spot-point directional move in the subsequent 30-90 seconds before the momentum exhausts.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute Bollinger Band width below 0.0015 threshold followed by close outside band with 1.5x volume ratio, signaling micro-consolidation breakout

name: bollinger_squeeze_breakout_v82
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday consolidation phases see order book depth build on both sides as directional participants cancel positions and market makers tighten spreads. This compresses realized volatility, causing 3-minute Bollinger Bands to narrow inside Keltner Channels (the TTM Squeeze). When price pushes above the upper Bollinger Band while the squeeze is still active, it signals that aggressive buyers have begun absorbing the resting offers — the balance tips and algorithmic momentum strategies cascade in, initiating a 15-30 spot point directional push in 30-90 seconds. The asymmetry at entry is that the squeeze constrains the losing scenario (tight bands = limited adverse price range) while the breakout release gives an outsized winner.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-minute Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channel (TTM Squeeze active) with price closing above upper BB or below lower BB

name: bollinger_squeeze_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when 5-second Bollinger bandwidth compresses to a 10-minute session low, latency-sensitive HFT algorithms probe the range edges with small directional orders looking for a breakout. When NIFTY closes outside the band without institutional follow-through — no sustained directional order flow visible as a series of higher closes — these probes are absorbed by market makers taking the opposite side, and the index snaps back toward the 20-bar SMA midline. At 5-second resolution we can enter the moment the probe closes outside the band (the failure signal itself), capturing the snap-back 30-90 seconds earlier than a 1-minute bar confirmation would allow. Reversion targets the midline typically 4-10 spot points away.
core_signal_oneliner: Bollinger bandwidth in bottom 20th percentile of 10-minute history while price closes outside band, signaling a failed probe that will snap back to midline

name: bollinger_squeeze_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic participants — VWAP-execution bots and market-makers delta-hedging gamma from near-expiry option books — temporarily pause directional order flow during mid-session consolidations, creating 2-5 minute compressions where the 4-minute Bollinger Band width contracts inside the Keltner Channel. This squeeze state signals a temporary equilibrium between absorbed buy and sell pressure. When the squeeze releases (BB expands beyond KC), it marks the resumption of institutional directional flow: a single large TWAP or delta-hedge cascade typically drives NIFTY 12-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds. The normalized momentum oscillator slope over the preceding 60 seconds distinguishes accumulation (slope turning positive → buy CE) from distribution (slope turning negative → buy PE) at the moment of release.
core_signal_oneliner: 4-minute BB contracts inside Keltner Channel for 6+ bars then expands beyond KC, with momentum oscillator slope confirming direction at the release bar

name: bootstrap_confidence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional and FII directional orders create persistent 5-second return autocorrelation that lasts 5-15 minutes as TWAP/VWAP algorithms steadily absorb liquidity. A block bootstrap CI (90%) built from the last 120 five-second log returns (10-min window) being entirely above zero means: accounting for the serial correlation structure, the positive directional bias is statistically robust — not a single-bar spike diluted in the average, but a sustained regime. When this condition fires on NIFTY, the same institutional order flow that created the statistical significance still has inventory to deploy, making the next 30-90 seconds of continuation probabilistically favorable. The CI width adapts naturally to current volatility regimes — wide in choppy markets (few signals) and narrow in trending markets (more signals), creating a self-filtering mechanism without explicit regime detection.
core_signal_oneliner: 90% block bootstrap confidence interval of the last 10 minutes of 5-second log returns is entirely above (or below) zero, confirming statistically significant directional bias

name: changepoint_detection_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms and macro news events generate persistent cumulative return deviations that build bar-by-bar before any lagging indicator confirms a trend. CUSUM (Cumulative Sum) control charts accumulate these micro-deviations against a 5-minute rolling baseline: the moment the positive CUSUM first crosses a volatility-scaled threshold, the index has entered a new buying regime where institutional demand is absorbing offers faster than the rolling mean. At 5-second resolution, we enter within the first 15-30 seconds of a new regime — before momentum strategies trigger and price moves further — riding the early continuation of the institutional order flow.
core_signal_oneliner: CUSUM of 5-second returns versus 5-minute rolling baseline crosses a volatility-scaled threshold for the first time, signaling a new directional regime onset

name: closing_auction_anticipation_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 15:00-15:20 window concentrates institutional closing flow — index fund rebalancers matching NAV benchmarks, FII basket orders, and algorithmic TWAP executors finishing daily programs all lean in the same direction that the index has been trending over the prior 30 minutes. When NIFTY has moved more than 0.15% over the prior 30 minutes with volume accelerating into 15:00, these closing orders reinforce the directional bias and create a sharp 12-20 spot-point burst in the first 60-120 seconds. At 5-second resolution we enter at the first 15:00 bar and exit within 2 minutes — capturing only the initial surge of closing flow before the order book becomes diffuse near 15:20.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY has trended >0.15% over prior 30 minutes, is above/below session VWAP, and volume is accelerating at 15:00 IST, anticipating concentrated institutional closing flow

name: connors_rsi_extreme_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the Connors RSI composite (averaging RSI(6) of the last 30-second price move, RSI(2) of the consecutive-bar streak, and 100-bar percentile rank of 5-second returns) drops below 10, three independent exhaustion signals converge simultaneously: the 30-second price RSI is deeply oversold, the streak of consecutive down-closes has worsened, and the current bar's return sits in the bottom percentile of the recent intraday distribution. At this confluence, VWAP-benchmarked institutional programs on NIFTY — which benchmark against the current session average — treat sub-VWAP prices at this extreme CRSI depth as below-benchmark accumulation opportunities, initiating buy-side absorption within 15-30 seconds. We enter on the turning bar where CRSI first crosses back above the oversold threshold, confirming the exhaustion is complete rather than catching a falling knife.
core_signal_oneliner: Connors RSI (composite of 30s price RSI, streak RSI, and 8-minute return percentile rank) crosses back above extreme oversold or below extreme overbought threshold near VWAP

name: consolidation_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, after a 15-25 spot point directional move, the index frequently enters a 5-10 minute tight consolidation (< 0.1% range) as institutional participants — index arb desks, FII program algos — place large resting limit orders at the consolidation ceiling and floor, absorbing counter-directional flow while filling their own position. At 5-second resolution, the precise bar where these resting limit orders are exhausted is identifiable: close crosses above the consolidation ceiling (or below the floor) simultaneously with a volume surge (1.5x average), signaling that the absorption side is depleted. In the 30-90 seconds that follow, competing momentum algos recognize the breakout and pile in, sustaining the continuation move for 10-20 NIFTY spot points — capturing the first wave before retracement.
core_signal_oneliner: 10-minute rolling range below 0.1% followed by close breaking the range ceiling/floor with 1.5x volume, confirming continuation of a prior directional move

name: demark_sequential_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second bars, a TD Sequential buy setup (9 consecutive 5s bars each closing below their 4-bar-ago close) captures a 45-second sustained micro-selldown where incremental sellers dominate at each price step. When the 9-count completes with DeMark perfection (bar 8 or 9 registers a lower low than bar 6 of the setup), the marginal sellers have been absorbed by resting buy orders at progressively deeper levels — supply is structurally exhausted. NIFTY's institutional-driven price discovery then snaps back within 1-3 bars as delta-hedging market makers and VWAP-benchmarked algos resume upward reference price tracking, producing a 10-20 spot point counter-move in the first 30-60 seconds. The sell setup is symmetric: 9 consecutive closes above close[4] with perfected higher high on bar 8 or 9 signals buyer exhaustion, triggering a buy PE.
core_signal_oneliner: 9 consecutive 5-second bars each closing below/above the bar 4 periods ago, with DeMark perfection on bar 8 or 9 and RSI confirmation, marking micro-trend exhaustion

name: deviation_from_ema_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index deviates sharply from its 5-minute EMA — reflected as a z-score exceeding ±1.5 standard deviations of recent deviations — VWAP-benchmarked execution algorithms and market makers begin absorbing the overshoot. These participants are accumulating at prices well better than their benchmark, creating a floor (or ceiling) that arrests the drift and initiates a micro snap-back. At 5-second resolution we detect the first bar where the deviation z-score peaks and reverses (narrowing), signalling that fresh counter-directional orders have entered the book. The ATM CE or PE captures the initial 30-90 second reversion leg before the EMA is reached.
core_signal_oneliner: 10-minute rolling z-score of distance from 5-minute EMA exceeds ±1.5 and has begun narrowing (z-score peak confirmed), signaling institutional counter-flow absorption

name: divergence_plus_level_confluence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index sells down to test a structural level — PDL, session VWAP, or a major round number like 22000 or 22500 — resting institutional buy orders at those pre-programmed price points absorb incremental selling. RSI bullish divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low) measured over the past 5 minutes confirms that selling momentum is thinning precisely as price arrives at the structural support: each successive push lower takes more selling to achieve, while passive buyers hold the level. The level provides a structural reason for reversal (stop clustering, VWAP-benchmarked algorithm accumulation) while divergence confirms momentum exhaustion — two independent reasons to reverse. Bearish divergence at PDH or VWAP resistance symmetrically marks exhaustion of buy-side flow at distributed institutional sell levels, triggering a 15-25 spot point reversal that translates to 7-12 option premium points.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute RSI divergence (price new extreme, RSI higher/lower low) coinciding with price proximity to PDH, PDL, session VWAP, or round number structural level

name: donchian_channel_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY closes above its 5-minute Donchian channel high with a volume surge, systematic CTA and momentum algorithms that scan for N-period price extremes simultaneously trigger buy signals, creating a burst of institutional order flow over the next 30-90 seconds. Because NIFTY is index-aggregated (not a single stock), this breakout is not noise — it reflects broad market participation overcoming the supply zone established during the prior 5 minutes. The volume confirmation filters out wick-driven false breaks: a real breakout requires active demand, not a single large print. The VWAP alignment filter ensures the breakout is consistent with the session's dominant directional flow rather than a counter-trend spike.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY close above 5-minute Donchian channel high (or below low) with 1.3x volume surge and VWAP directional alignment in moderate VIX environment

name: drawdown_adaptive_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms create directional micro-trends detectable by Supertrend(2-min ATR) — when NIFTY is in a bullish Supertrend AND trading above session VWAP, buy-side program flow is dominant at multiple timescales and 30-60 second continuation is high-probability. The drawdown-adaptive layer tracks NIFTY's intraday session high-water mark: beyond 0.4% session drawdown, CE entries are suppressed (market is in a distribution/sell-program regime where Supertrend bullish whipsaws are common), and beyond 0.7% session drawdown all entries halt (index is in stress/liquidation mode where the signal degrades entirely). This regime filter mirrors the original's anti-martingale logic — during index drawdown, the order book skews bearish and a Supertrend long is fighting institutional flow.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute Supertrend direction aligned with VWAP position for 2+ consecutive bars, with session drawdown below 0.4% gating CE entries and 0.7% halting all entries

name: dynamic_stop_regime_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 60-second EMA crosses above the 3-minute EMA while the index is trading above session VWAP, it signals that short-term institutional order flow is accelerating faster than the medium-term drift — typically the early signature of a TWAP/VWAP algorithm that has absorbed initial supply and is now moving the market directionally. The critical adaptation for option premium management at 5-second resolution: NIFTY's ATR percentile over the preceding 10 minutes reliably classifies the microstructure volatility regime. In compressed-volatility regimes (ATR percentile < 30), EMA crossovers generate clean 15-25 spot-point directional moves that translate to 3-5 option premium points, and tight 3-point stops work because noise is minimal. In high-volatility bursts (ATR percentile > 70), the same crossover signal requires 7-point premium stops to survive the inevitable retest before the 12-point continuation move materializes — failing to widen stops in these regimes is the primary source of noise-triggered exits on NIFTY.
core_signal_oneliner: 60-second EMA crosses 3-minute EMA with VWAP alignment and volume confirmation, with stop size dynamically set to 3/5/7 points based on 10-minute ATR percentile regime

name: elder_impulse_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute EMA slope and the MACD(12,36,9) histogram slope simultaneously turn upward ('green impulse'), large institutional TWAP/VWAP orders are absorbing sell-side liquidity at multiple bid levels — the EMA captures the persistent directional drift while the accelerating MACD histogram signals that buy-side order flow intensity is growing, not plateauing. name: hmm_regime_v1

name: hull_ma_momentum_v1

name: hurst_exponent_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the Hurst exponent of the 10-minute (120-bar at 5s) log-return series distinguishes two distinct microstructure states: when H > 0.55, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms are executing directional orders, and each 5-second bar absorbs part of that flow — consecutive bars are autocorrelated, creating exploitable momentum over 30-90 seconds. core_signal_oneliner: Hurst exponent classifies trending (H>0.55) vs mean-reverting (H<0.45) regime, then applies EMA or Bollinger entry

name: ichimoku_cloud_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the Tenkan-sen (7-bar = 35-second equilibrium midpoint) crossing above or below the Kijun-sen (22-bar = 110-second base equilibrium) signals a micro-regime shift in institutional order flow direction. When this TK cross occurs while price is already positioned above the Ichimoku cloud (defined by 44-bar Senkou Span B = 220-second extreme range midpoint), NIFTY's prevailing short-term institutional demand has overcome both the fast and base equilibria — a signal that TWAP/VWAP algorithms are sustaining directional pressure across multiple timescales, not just spiking. False TK crosses are frequent in NIFTY's characteristic intraday chop, but requiring price to be outside the cloud reduces qualifying signals to 30-40% of all crosses, and those aligned with the cloud regime tend to generate 14-20 additional spot points of follow-through within 60 seconds before the next equilibrium re-establishes.
core_signal_oneliner: Tenkan-Kijun cross with price fully outside the Ichimoku cloud confirming multi-scale institutional alignment

name: implied_vol_dislocation_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX is significantly elevated relative to the index's own rolling 5-minute realized volatility, options market makers are pricing in more risk than actual price action warrants — they have accumulated excess long-delta spot positions from delta-hedging short puts at inflated IV, and as each bar passes without the feared volatility materializing, that hedge-unwind pressure eases and creates a mild upward drift (buy CE when ratio z-score is high and 1-min return turns positive). Conversely, when NIFTY's 5-minute realized vol sharply exceeds VIX, an unexpected volatility burst is underway: institutional stop-loss cascades are moving the index faster than options participants priced, and the directional momentum — confirmed by the 1-minute return — tends to persist for another 15-45 seconds before options repricing can catch up (buy PE when RV > VIX and 1-min return is negative).
core_signal_oneliner: VIX vs 5-minute realized vol z-score dislocation with 1-minute directional momentum confirmation

name: implied_vs_realized_vol_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when VIX has spiked intraday but 20-minute realized volatility has not kept pace, market makers who sold calls into the fear spike are over-hedged short-delta and will buy the index to unwind as VIX begins to revert. We detect this regime by computing the intraday VRP (VIX/100 minus 20-min annualized realized vol) and z-scoring it over the trailing 60-minute window; when VRP z-score exceeds 1.5 and VIX's 5-minute rate-of-change turns negative (confirming the spike is reversing), NIFTY tends to drift upward 15-25 spot points over the following 30-90 seconds as dealer delta hedges unwind. The short leg fires when RV exceeds implied vol (VRP z-score < -1.5) with VIX rising, signaling complacency before a move.
core_signal_oneliner: Intraday variance risk premium z-score with VIX rate-of-change direction confirmation for dealer delta unwind

name: index_correlated_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, whenever a bar closes above the running intraday session high, it signals that institutional VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that were patiently accumulating on earlier dips have finally absorbed all intraday supply — their execution models flip from 'passive fill' to 'active momentum' mode. The edge is highest when: (1) the breakout occurs above VWAP — confirming the institutional side of the ledger is net-long for the session — and (2) a 1-minute momentum buildup precedes the new high, distinguishing a sustained institutional push from a retail spike that fails within 2-3 bars. Session-high breakouts that occur mid-session (after 09:30, when all opening range noise has cleared) carry stronger institutional weight than ORB breakouts because they overcome all intraday supply that accumulated post-open.
core_signal_oneliner: New intraday session high/low breakout with VWAP alignment, 1-minute momentum buildup, and volume surge

name: index_momentum_stock_selection_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY has established >0.5% return from the day's open by 10:00 IST, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing buy-side mandates (FII inflows, mutual fund SIPs deployed intraday) remain active through the morning session, absorbing short-term supply and creating a persistent directional bias. core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY morning momentum regime (>0.5% from open by 10:00) confirmed by 2-minute aligned return for re-entry

name: index_momentum_v1

core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute trend confirmed by 1-minute acceleration alignment for institutional order completion continuation

name: inside_bar_breakout_v177
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp 5-second directional bars (>=5 index points range) represent algorithmic momentum bursts where a single institutional order temporarily dominates. The subsequent inside bar forms as market makers reprice and resting limit orders absorb the thrust — a micro-equilibrium where neither bulls nor bears commit. When the next 5-second bar closes beyond the inside bar's boundary in the direction of the mother bar, trapped opposing-side stop-losses trigger and the momentum algos re-enter, driving a 10-20 spot point continuation. core_signal_oneliner: Inside bar breakout in direction of large-range mother bar with 3-minute trend alignment

name: institutional_flow_momentum_v1

core_signal_oneliner: 4x volume spike bar with directional price impact above/below VWAP for institutional order follow-through

name: intraday_momentum_ema_cross_v1

When the 1-min EMA(12) freshly crosses above the 3-min EMA(36) with ADX(36) > 20 and price above session VWAP, it indicates order flow is directionally persistent across multiple successive 5-second bars — not a spike but continuous absorption by institutional buyers. At 5-second resolution, entering at the fresh crossover bar captures the first 10-15 NIFTY spot points of the continuation impulse before the next wave of TWAP orders arrives.
core_signal_oneliner: Fresh 1-minute EMA cross above 3-minute EMA with ADX trend strength and VWAP alignment

name: intraday_range_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the session high and low become self-reinforcing order magnets: systematic TWAP/VWAP algorithms, stop-limit clusters, and delta-hedging desks concentrate resting orders at these levels throughout the day. When NIFTY touches its session extreme and the 5-second bar forms a rejection candle (close in the upper 65% of bar range at session low, lower 65% at session high), it signals that the algorithmic buy or sell wall has absorbed the directional flow. Within 30-90 seconds, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms aggressively fade the extreme because their fill price relative to benchmark has become highly attractive, driving a 12-25 spot point reversion toward the session midpoint.
core_signal_oneliner: Rejection pin bar at session high or low with meaningful intraday range and moderate VIX regime

name: intraday_rsi_divergence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional algo selling (or buying) drives the index to a new 1-minute price extreme, but RSI at that extreme is higher (for a lower low) or lower (for a higher high) than it was at the prior extreme 1 minute earlier, it signals that the directional order flow is decelerating — fewer contracts are absorbing per tick even as price extends. At 5-second resolution this deceleration is visible before the full reversal, giving a 30-90 second lead. Market-maker delta-hedging amplifies the initial snap-back because they are unwinding hedges placed during the directional leg as flow exhausts. The divergence must form in RSI oversold (<45) or overbought (>55) territory to confirm the exhaustion context rather than catching mid-range noise.
core_signal_oneliner: Price makes new 1-minute extreme but RSI diverges, confirming directional momentum deceleration in oversold/overbought territory

name: intraday_trend_channel_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP algorithms executing large directional baskets create smooth micro-trends at 3-minute resolution — the index moves in an almost-linear ramp as these orders absorb liquidity one 5-second auction at a time. When a 3-minute linear regression channel carries a positive slope and price pulls back to the lower 2-sigma boundary, it signals a temporary deceleration within an ongoing institutional buying program, not a reversal. The symmetric logic applies in downtrend channels — shorts defending the upper boundary get squeezed back to midline as short-covering resumes.
core_signal_oneliner: Price touches 2-sigma lower/upper boundary of a stable 3-minute linear regression channel for midline reversion

name: intraday_trend_following_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms are working directional orders over 10-20 minute windows, they create a persistent EMA alignment visible as the 2-minute EMA sustaining itself above the 10-minute EMA. core_signal_oneliner: EMA(24) pullback and bounce with 10-minute EMA trend alignment and VWAP above-filter

name: intraday_vol_pattern_v1
mechanism: NIFTY exhibits a structural U-shaped intraday volatility pattern driven by institutional order concentration: FIIs and domestic institutions front-load directional orders at the open (09:15-10:00) and close (14:30-15:25), creating algorithmic TWAP/VWAP-driven surges where EMA alignment holds for 30-90 seconds; during lunch (11:30-13:30) institutional desks park positions and retail/market-maker activity dominates, so NIFTY drifts in a narrow 30-50 spot pt range and Bollinger Band touches revert reliably because no sustained buy/sell programs are active. When vol drops 15%+ below baseline during lunch, BB extremes represent temporary order-book imbalances that self-correct within 60-90 seconds as market makers fade the deviation.
core_signal_oneliner: Time-of-day vol ratio switches between EMA momentum (open/close) and Bollinger Band mean-reversion (lunch) regimes

name: intraday_volatility_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's 1-minute realized volatility (ATR over the last 12 bars at 5-second resolution) suddenly exceeds its 5-minute baseline ATR by 2x or more, institutional order flow or macro news has shifted market microstructure into a high-volatility regime. We enter in the direction of the initial expansion bar — confirmed by a relative volume surge above the 5-minute average — to capture the first leg of this institutional feedback loop before the delta-hedge demand is absorbed.
core_signal_oneliner: ATR expansion 2x above 5-minute baseline with directional volume surge and VWAP alignment for delta-hedge cascade entry

name: kalman_filter_trend_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's intraday trends are driven by institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional mandates over 5-20 minute windows, creating persistent but noise-embedded price drift visible in 5-second bars. A Kalman filter with 2 states (price level + velocity) optimally separates genuine trend velocity from observation noise by dynamically adjusting its gain: when the index is in persistent directional flow, the velocity state converges to a stable non-zero value with low estimation uncertainty, yielding a high velocity/uncertainty ratio. When NIFTY's Kalman velocity/sigma exceeds 1.5 in one direction AND price sits above/below the Kalman level estimate AND agrees with session VWAP direction — institutional order flow is active and unexhausted. On NIFTY, these confirmed velocity regimes persist for 30-90 additional seconds, delivering 5-15 option premium points before the institutional batch exhausts and velocity reverts toward zero.
core_signal_oneliner: Kalman velocity/uncertainty ratio above 1.5 sustained 30 seconds with VWAP directional agreement

name: keltner_channel_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index price touches the outer Keltner Channel (EMA(24) ± 2.0 × ATR(24) = ±2 ATR from the 2-minute EMA), intraday momentum algorithms that drove the move have exhausted near-term order flow and the ATR-based band marks a micro-volatility-normalized extreme. Unlike Bollinger Bands that inflate on single outlier bars, ATR bands reflect the true recent micro-volatility — so a Keltner touch is a cleaner signal that the LAST bar was genuinely outsized relative to the prior 2 minutes of movement. At this point, delta-hedging dealers (long gamma from options they sold) and short-term mean-reversion desks that use EMA-anchored bands start fading aggressively with limit orders. The 5-second close BACK inside the band — with a bullish/bearish body showing that the current bar itself absorbed the excess — is the entry signal, targeting reversion to the 2-minute EMA within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Price wicks outside 2-ATR Keltner band then closes back inside with confirming body in flat EMA regime

name: keltner_channel_trend_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index sustains above its 5-minute Keltner Channel upper band (EMA(60) + 2×ATR(60)) for 3 consecutive 5-second bars, it signals institutional directional flow has overwhelmed the volatility-adjusted supply ceiling — the band is harder to breach than Bollinger Bands because ATR widens in choppy conditions, so a sustained breach specifically means price velocity exceeds current micro-volatility regime, not just a single-bar noise spike. TWAP/VWAP algorithms filling large directional orders continue pushing for 30-90 seconds as only 40-60% of institutional orders are typically filled at the breakout bar. The ADX(36) filter confirms that +DI and -DI have diverged meaningfully over the past 3 minutes, validating that the breakout is driven by directional flow rather than a two-sided auction spike.
core_signal_oneliner: Sustained 15-second breach of 5-minute Keltner band above VWAP with ADX trend strength confirmation

name: kernel_density_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP and VWAP algorithms executing multi-hour directional mandates repeatedly transact at the same price bands within any given 10-minute window, creating high-density clusters in the Gaussian KDE of recent 5-second closes. These KDE modes act as mechanical support/resistance: when NIFTY approaches a high-density mode from above with short-term RSI exhausted below 40, residual buy algorithms still working their orders at that level absorb the incoming sell flow and produce a 10-20 spot-point bounce. The same logic applies in reverse at resistance modes (RSI > 60, approaching from below), where sellers who accumulated near that band provide friction against further advance. At 5-second resolution we enter as proximity to the mode tightens to within 0.1% of price, capturing the first 1-2 bars of bounce before the level either holds or breaks.
core_signal_oneliner: Gaussian KDE mode proximity with RSI momentum exhaustion for bounce off high-density price cluster

name: lasso_feature_select_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second resolution, the relative predictive power of individual technical indicators shifts continuously throughout the session: momentum signals (MACD histogram, 1-min ROC) dominate during institutional TWAP/VWAP execution windows that create sustained 30-90 second directional bursts, while mean-reversion signals (VWAP distance, RSI) dominate during gamma-hedging chop between those order blocks. A LASSO regression model refitted every 5 minutes on the trailing 60 minutes of 5-second NIFTY data automatically selects which subset of 9 technical features currently has non-zero predictive power for the next 60-second index return — zeroing out irrelevant features and adapting to intraday regime shifts without requiring manual regime detection. When the sparse model (at least 2 active features) predicts a positive 60-second return exceeding the threshold, we buy NIFTY ATM CE; when it predicts a negative return below the negative threshold, we buy NIFTY ATM PE.
core_signal_oneliner: Rolling LASSO regression on 9 technical features predicts 60-second NIFTY return with sparse regime-adaptive weighting

name: last_30_min_momentum_v1

When NIFTY has accumulated a >0.3% directional day return and remains on the correct side of session VWAP at 14:45, these late institutional orders reinforce the day's direction in 30-90 second micro-bursts — not one sustained push but sequential order batches from different fund managers executing their end-of-day mandates at staggered times. At 5-second resolution we detect each burst as it begins (positive 1-minute momentum aligning with the day direction) rather than taking a single time-based entry held through noise until 15:29.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY closing window institutional burst detected by 1-minute momentum aligned to day direction and VWAP side

name: liquidity_provision_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional VWAP algorithms account for ~20-30% of daily buy-side volume and operate with a natural mean-reverting footprint: when NIFTY briefly dips below the tight VWAP lower band (0.5 σ computed over the recent 5 minutes), VWAP algos accelerate order submission because they're getting fills at prices significantly better than their benchmark — this burst of demand drives price back toward VWAP within 15-90 seconds. This effect is strongest when volume participation is normal (confirming active VWAP algo presence) and VIX < 18 (in high-VIX regimes, trend/panic flow overwhelms VWAP benchmark logic).
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY deviates beyond 0.5-sigma VWAP band in normal volume regime triggering VWAP algo re-entry reversion

name: low_vol_compression_long_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute realized volatility (24 five-second bars) compresses to below 55% of the 30-minute session baseline, institutional TWAP and HFT algorithms have entered a passive, non-directional mode — neither sending large sweeps nor triggering momentum. This creates a coiled-spring microstructure: resting limit orders accumulate on both sides of the book, spreads tighten, and price oscillates within a narrow band. The first macro trigger — FII block order, global index impulse, or news reaction — causes a cascade of stop orders and momentum algos to activate simultaneously, producing a rapid 15-25 spot point expansion. VWAP position at the moment of expansion reveals which side of accumulated demand is larger: if NIFTY is above VWAP when the range expansion bar fires, VWAP-benchmarked buyers are still net accumulators and the move favors upside.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute realized vol below 55% of 30-minute baseline followed by range expansion bar in VWAP-aligned direction

name: low_vol_momentum_v1

core_signal_oneliner: Low intraday vol regime (5-min vol < 80% of 20-min baseline) with 1/5-minute EMA alignment and confirming bar

name: lunch_hour_range_compression_v1
mechanism: During 12:00-13:30, NIFTY's order flow shrinks as large domestic institutional desks pause rebalancing and algo momentum strategies reduce size in the low-information lunch window — the index typically compresses to a 30-50 spot point range (vs 70-120 points in the morning). The first 30-90 seconds of the breakout carries persistent directionality as the initial institutional order blocks — sized in hundreds of crores — cannot be fully absorbed by resting liquidity instantly, creating autocorrelation in the NIFTY spot order book.
core_signal_oneliner: Post-lunch breakout of 12:00-13:30 compressed range with volume surge and morning trend alignment

name: ma_crossover_momentum_v1

core_signal_oneliner: Fresh 2-minute/10-minute EMA crossover with 1-minute momentum confirmation within 5 minutes of crossover

name: macd_histogram_divergence_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY experiences a sustained intraday decline, algorithmic momentum sellers execute in sequential waves. Each wave encounters better-rested resting buy orders at each new price low, causing the rate of decline to diminish even as price continues lower. The MACD histogram (12/26/9 on 5s bars ≈ 60s/130s/45s windows) captures this exhaustion precisely: a shallower histogram trough compared to the prior trough, while price prints a new low, reveals that NIFTY's net selling force is contracting. The histogram zero-cross above 0 then confirms that VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers have begun active accumulation, producing a sharp 15-30 second bounce. The symmetric bearish divergence — higher price highs with lower histogram peaks — flags institutional buy-side exhaustion where resting sell orders at new highs are absorbing demand more effectively, preceding a sharp fade.
core_signal_oneliner: MACD histogram divergence at price swing extreme followed by histogram zero-cross confirming momentum exhaustion reversal

name: macd_signal_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms running directional orders create persistent EMA divergence that is visible in MACD at any timescale. When the MACD histogram (EMA_24 minus EMA_72, net of its 18-bar EMA) accelerates for 3 consecutive 5-second bars — meaning the short-term momentum is compounding rather than plateauing — it signals the institutional order is mid-execution, not near completion. NIFTY's tight liquidity and high notional volume ensure this histogram acceleration reflects genuine cumulative order flow rather than noise. Adding VWAP directional confirmation means we trade only when the institutional momentum aligns with the dominant session benchmark, filtering signals where counter-flow will resist continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: MACD histogram accelerating monotonically for 3 consecutive 5-second bars, confirming mid-execution institutional directional order flow

name: macd_trend_continuation_v71
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing multi-minute directional orders create persistent 3-8 minute micro-trends visible via EMA(60) slope. Within these micro-trends, 20-40 second pullbacks cause the 5s MACD to dip briefly negative. When the MACD histogram crosses back above its signal line while still negative, it marks the moment institutional buying has resumed before the full momentum re-accelerates — resting buy orders just absorbed the pullback supply, and the directional order flow is restarting. At 5-second resolution we enter this resumption point 10-20 seconds before it becomes visible on 1-minute bars, capturing the first 10-15 NIFTY spot points of continuation (5-7 option pts at delta ~0.5).
core_signal_oneliner: MACD histogram crossing from negative to positive (zero-cross) during a pullback while the 5-minute EMA trend remains intact, signaling institutional order flow resumption

name: market_profile_poc_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the developing session Market Profile concentrates the majority of traded volume within a Value Area (VA) that shifts incrementally as institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms and market makers repeatedly transact near the session's fairest price — the Point of Control (POC). When NIFTY briefly probes outside the VA boundary (a 10-25 spot point excursion) but fails to sustain a close outside the VA for more than 30 seconds, it signals that the initiative selling/buying was absorbed rather than welcomed. VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that filled orders at the VA boundary now delta-hedge or rebalance toward POC, creating a directional pull of 10-20 NIFTY spot points within 30-90 seconds.

name: market_state_classifier_v1

name: orb_plus_sector_filter_v1

name: orb_pullback_entry_v1

name: orb_retest_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30) establishes an opening range whose high and low serve as the primary intraday reference levels for institutional VWAP algorithms, options market makers delta-hedging against gamma exposure accumulated at open, and systematic breakout programs that sized in on the initial move. core_signal_oneliner: Mid-session ORB level retest where intrabar low touches within proximity of ORB high and 15s momentum confirms the bounce

name: orb_vwap_confirmation_v1

name: order_block_entry_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional algorithms execute concentrated directional orders within a 15-second window (3 × 5s bars), the net 8+ spot point impulse consumes all opposing limit orders at those price levels. The last opposite-direction candle immediately before that impulse — the Order Block — contains residual unfilled resting orders from participants whose limit orders were never reached during the rush. When NIFTY retraces to this zone within 5-6 minutes, those resting limit buy/sell orders re-engage and absorb the pullback, launching a fresh directional push of 15-25 spot points. Fair Value Gaps (3-bar price discontinuities where candle i-2's extreme fails to overlap with candle i's extreme at 5-second resolution) mark levels where NIFTY's continuous auction skipped price tiers during aggressive institutional sweeps — market makers fill these gaps with directional pushes as NIFTY revisits the untraded zone, producing a short-lived but cleanly directional 15-30 spot point continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: Price returns to an Order Block or Fair Value Gap zone created by a 15-second institutional impulse, entry on first touch within 6 minutes of zone creation

name: order_flow_imbalance_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional algorithms are working large directional orders via TWAP/VWAP execution, each 5-second bar exhibits a measurable volume tilt: heavier volume on uptick bars (close > open) than downtick bars during accumulation, and the reverse during distribution. Cumulating this volume-weighted bar_delta (volume × sign(close − open)) over a 1-minute window and z-scoring it against a 5-minute rolling baseline captures abnormal buy/sell pressure before it fully manifests in price. When this z-score exceeds ±1.5 and price confirms direction relative to session VWAP, the unexecuted tail of the institutional order typically pushes NIFTY a further 10-20 spot points within 30-90 seconds — unlike the unweighted direction proxy, high-volume bars carry proportionally more signal weight, making the z-score more sensitive to genuine institutional size rather than routine tick noise.
core_signal_oneliner: Volume-weighted bar delta z-score exceeds 1.5 standard deviations above 5-minute baseline, confirming abnormal institutional buy or sell pressure

name: overnight_gap_reversion_v1

name: overnight_vol_carry_v1

core_signal_oneliner: Daily regime classifier based on overnight gap ratio: oversized gaps trigger mean-reversion trades, near-flat opens trigger momentum trades, using 3-min RSI and EMA crossover for timing

name: pdh_pdl_fakeout_v141

name: prev_day_hl_reversal
mechanism: On NIFTY, the Previous Day High (PDH) and Previous Day Low (PDL) are watched by every algorithmic participant as primary reference levels. Institutional algos pre-positioned to fade the liquidity grab activate their sell orders, and the resulting order-book imbalance — trapped longs unwinding, no fresh demand above the level — pushes NIFTY down 15-25 spot points toward session VWAP within 30-90 seconds. The mirror mechanism applies at PDL: a false breakdown flushes long stops, absorbs resting sell orders, then resting buy orders above the level initiate a quick 15-25 pt bounce as panicked shorts cover.
core_signal_oneliner: Previous day high/low intrabar pierce-and-reject reversal: bar high exceeds PDH but closes back below, confirmed by 2-min RSI exhaustion

core_signal_oneliner: PDH/PDL breakout on NIFTY or BANKNIFTY confirmed by 3-bar persistence, 5-min volume surge >1.5x, VWAP alignment, and VIX < 22

name: previous_day_hl_breakout_v1

name: price_channel_breakout_v1

name: price_impact_reversion_v1

name: psychological_level_mean_reversion
mechanism: On NIFTY, retail options traders and semi-institutional participants densely cluster stop-loss orders and protective limit orders at round 100-multiple levels (24000, 24100, 23900, etc.) because financial media and brokerage platforms display these levels as natural reference points. At 5-second resolution we detect the pierce (price within 0.06% of the round level, just below it) combined with 3-minute RSI exhaustion below 35, entering as the bounce begins rather than waiting for a full bar confirmation.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY within 0.06% of a round 100-multiple level with 3-min RSI exhaustion below 35 (oversold) or above 65 (overbought), signalling stop-hunt snapback

name: pullback_momentum_v1

name: pullback_to_vwap_trend_ride

core_signal_oneliner: Price retraces to VWAP within an ADX-confirmed 5-min uptrend and prints a bullish 5s bar, triggering VWAP-algo re-entry

name: quality_momentum_v1

A 5-minute ROC above 15 bps confirms the move has macro follow-through across the prior 60 bars. The VWAP position filter ensures the trade aligns with the session's dominant order flow direction, filtering entries where spot has already overshot.
