name: quantile_regression_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when VWAP deviation, volume surge, and 1-minute momentum all simultaneously reach extreme levels in the same direction, the joint conditional distribution of the next 30-60 second return is so heavily skewed that even the pessimistic 10th quantile is positive. This three-way alignment signals that VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms are actively accumulating (above-VWAP price forces them to buy at benchmark), confirmed by real order flow (1.3x volume surge) and sustained directional commitment (positive 1-min return). Rather than fitting a full quantile regression model, we approximate the QR_P10 > 0 condition by requiring all three predictors to simultaneously hit extreme composite territory — trading only when the full distribution is shifted, not just the mean.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP deviation, volume surge, and 1-min momentum all simultaneously reach extremes in the same direction, shifting the full return distribution

name: range_day_band_fade_003
mechanism: On NIFTY, range-bound sessions (ADX < 20, flat 5-minute VWAP slope) create a microstructure where VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms aggressively defend prices that deviate 0.05-0.10% from session VWAP — they treat every tick away from benchmark as a free fill opportunity and immediately place opposing limit orders. When 1-minute MFI simultaneously reaches extreme (≤22 or ≥78), it confirms that short-term buying or selling pressure has exhausted available counterparty interest, leaving only the VWAP algos on one side of the book. The 20-minute Bollinger band acts as a safety filter: if price has already pierced the band, the move is a regime break rather than an overreaction, and the fade is skipped. At 5-second resolution we enter the moment MFI exhaustion prints with a bullish/bearish close bar, capturing 5-8 option points of the first-leg VWAP reversion before the next directional impulse.
core_signal_oneliner: Price deviates from VWAP on a low-ADX range day while 1-minute MFI signals exhaustion, fading the deviation back toward VWAP

name: range_expansion_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index compresses into a 2-minute micro-consolidation (range < 0.08% of price, ~18 spot points at 22500), dominant algorithms have paused directional orders and limit orders have equilibrated at both range extremes — forming a compressed orderbook. The first 5-second bar expanding to more than 2.5x the base-period average bar range signals a large institutional basket or futures order breaking through resting limit orders on one side. This expansion bar consuming the base high (or low) triggers automated stops placed by participants positioned within the base, creating a self-reinforcing directional push that sustains for 60-90 seconds. On NIFTY specifically — more liquid and less gappy than single stocks — these micro-expansions generate cleaner continuation because there are no single-stock event gaps to contaminate the signal.
core_signal_oneliner: A 5s bar expands to 2.5x the 2-min average bar range and closes above a tight 2-min consolidation base, signaling orderbook rupture

name: regime_detection_vol_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms switch between passive accumulation (quiet low-vol regime) and aggressive directional execution (high-vol regime) in bursts visible at 5-second resolution. When 3-minute realized vol spikes above 2x the 10-minute baseline vol, it signals that aggressive directional flow has activated — the side confirmed by EMA_24 vs EMA_72 alignment predicts 15-25 spot point continuation over the next 30-120 seconds as the institutional order works through remaining fills. Conversely, when the vol ratio collapses back below the threshold (flow exhausted), price has overshot VWAP by 15-30 spot points and market makers who delta-hedged during the high-vol burst close their hedges, snapping price back toward VWAP within 60-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-min realized vol crosses above/below 2x the 10-min baseline, signaling a switch between aggressive institutional flow and post-burst VWAP reversion

name: relative_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional directional orders (FII equity block deals, domestic fund rebalancing) execute over 30-180 minutes via TWAP algorithms that create a gentle session drift. When the 2-minute return rate suddenly exceeds twice the session drift rate, it signals these orders have entered an urgency phase — either a new buyer joined an existing trend or a staggered TWAP order accelerated near its deadline. At 5-second resolution, this acceleration is detectable ~15 seconds before a 1-minute bar confirms it, and the institutional flow typically sustains for another 30-90 seconds as the order continues filling. The session drift rate normalises for time-of-day effects: a 0.3% move at 09:45 (30 min in) is the same drift rate as 1.2% at 13:00 (240 min in), preventing false signals from large opening moves.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute return rate exceeds 2x the session drift rate, detecting TWAP urgency phase acceleration

name: robust_regression_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP and VWAP algorithms executing large directional orders create persistent micro-trends over 3-7 minute windows. Individual block trades and sudden micro-news events generate outlier bars that bias OLS regression and obscure the genuine institutional flow direction; Huber IRLS down-weights these spike bars (residual > 1.35 * MAD) to reveal the true gradient of underlying demand. When the Huber slope t-statistic exceeds 2.0 on a 5-minute window (60 bars) and price dips back below the regression line, we are entering a confirmed TWAP buy-flow at a momentary intraday imbalance point — the ongoing order execution will absorb that imbalance and push spot back through the trend line within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Huber-IRLS regression on 5-min window shows t-stat > 2.0 uptrend and price dips below the regression line, signaling a TWAP-supported pullback entry

name: roc_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing large directional mandates compress their order flow into 1-2 minute windows, creating 1-minute ROC readings that rank in the top or bottom decile of the index's own intraday ROC distribution. Unlike single-stock momentum spikes (news, block deals), NIFTY's ROC extremes are driven by multi-participant flow — FII, prop desks, and index arb simultaneously — that requires 30-90 additional seconds to fully absorb. We detect these bursts by z-scoring the current 1-minute ROC against a rolling 20-minute baseline (adapting to the session's volatility regime), then entering in the direction of the burst only when the index is already on the correct side of session VWAP and volume is elevated, confirming genuine institutional activity rather than illiquid drift.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-min ROC z-score exceeds 1.8 SD above its 20-min baseline with elevated volume and VWAP alignment, signaling a multi-participant institutional burst

name: rolling_sharpe_adaptive_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, sustained institutional buy/sell programs create microtrend windows where the fast EMA (2-min) stays above the slow EMA (5-min) and price holds above VWAP — these reflect TWAP/VWAP algo order execution that persists for 30-120 seconds. The Rolling Signal Quality filter captures whether THIS session's microtrend structure is coherent: if over the last 3 minutes the EMA directional signal correctly predicted the next 5-second bar's direction more than ~52% of the time, the current regime is favorable (trending, not choppy). In contrast, when NIFTY is in a mean-reverting session, EMA/VWAP signals flip rapidly and the signal accuracy drops below 50% — the filter stands aside, avoiding the false breakouts that plague EMA strategies on range-bound NIFTY days. This regime-gating preserves the base EMA/VWAP edge while suppressing loss-making chop periods.
core_signal_oneliner: Fast EMA above slow EMA with VWAP alignment, gated by a rolling 3-min EMA directional accuracy filter to exclude choppy sessions

name: round_number_reversal_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY approaches a 100-point psychological level (22000, 22100, 22200, etc.), short call writers at that strike must sell NIFTY futures to maintain delta neutrality as gamma spikes — creating mechanical resistance as price rises toward the level. Symmetrically, short put writers buy NIFTY as it falls toward their strike, creating a mechanical demand floor. Retail traders simultaneously cluster limit orders and stop-losses at these round numbers (anchoring bias), so when NIFTY arrives at a 100-multiple with 2-minute RSI at an extreme (oversold near support, overbought near resistance) and 1-minute momentum waning, the combined mechanical delta-hedging demand plus order-book absorption generates a 10-15 spot point reversal over the next 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY within 12 pts of a 100-multiple with 1-min momentum waning and 2-min RSI in extreme territory, triggering delta-hedging-driven reversal

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v41
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working large directional orders create persistent intraday trends over 20-45 minute windows. Within these trends, reactive retail stops and short-term momentum algos trigger brief 10-30 second counter-trend micro-pullbacks visible as extremely low RSI(6) readings (30-second RSI). The institutional order that created the trend has not been fully filled — when the micro-counter-move exhausts at RSI < 25, the underlying TWAP buy side resumes and NIFTY snaps back in the trend direction within 15-60 seconds. The edge is that RSI(6) detects the last sellers/buyers capitulating before the institutional engine resumes.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-second RSI drops below 25 within a 30-min SMA uptrend, detecting micro-pullback exhaustion before TWAP engine resumes

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v42
mechanism: When NIFTY sustains above its 17-minute SMA — confirming institutional order flow is net bullish across the morning session — a sharp 30-second selloff that drives RSI(6) below 15 reflects transient stop-loss hunting by HFT scalpers or retail panic liquidation. On the NIFTY index, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos and index futures arbitrageurs treat these dips as favorable execution opportunities versus their daily benchmark, injecting coordinated buy flow within 15-45 seconds. NIFTY's index composition (50-stock basket) dampens the idiosyncratic gap risk that afflicts individual Connors setups, making the overshoot predictable and the mean-reversion swift. The mirror applies bearishly: RSI(6) > 85 while below the 17-minute SMA signals an exhaustion rally that short-selling algos fade aggressively.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-second RSI drops below 15 (or spikes above 85) while price is on the correct side of the 17-min SMA, signaling extreme micro-exhaustion with institutional support

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v46
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, micro-corrections within an intraday trend create extreme RSI(2) readings at 5-second resolution. When RSI(2) drops below 20 while the index remains above its 10-minute SMA, two consecutive sell-dominated 5-second bars have absorbed nearby resting buy orders, briefly exhausting immediate demand. Market makers and VWAP-benchmarked algos recognise this as a deviation from the prevailing flow and begin stepping in, snapping the index back within 30-60 seconds as the order book rebalances. The RSI(2) extreme marks local selling exhaustion, not trend reversal — the 10-minute SMA confirms the macro direction remains intact.
core_signal_oneliner: Ultra-short 2-bar RSI drops below 20 within a 10-min SMA uptrend, marking 10-second selling exhaustion before order-book rebalancing resumes

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v49
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional mandates over 15-30 minute windows create persistent micro-trends visible as price holding above the 15-minute SMA. Within these flows, every 60-120 seconds there is a brief momentum pause as one algo batch completes — visible as RSI(12) (1-minute RSI) dipping below 45 while the trend structure remains intact. At this exact point, passive limit orders from delta-hedging market makers (who are continuously re-hedging short-gamma positions) provide a structural bid that absorbs the temporary selling pressure, triggering resumption of the institutional flow. Entering ATM calls at RSI(12) < 45 while close remains above the 15-min SMA exploits this predictable 30-90 second re-acceleration in NIFTY's institutional order flow.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute RSI dips below 45 within a 15-min SMA uptrend, detecting the brief batch-completion pause in TWAP flow before re-acceleration

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v50
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, sharp 30-60 second micro-selloffs within the prevailing intraday VWAP-trend attract delta-hedging buy flow from option market makers and VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos who are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark. When 1-minute RSI (12 bars at 5s) drops below 20 while spot trades above session VWAP, the selling is counter to the dominant directional order flow — resting bid orders at VWAP-anchored levels absorb the downtick and the index reverts within 30-90 seconds as TWAP algos resume accumulation. The symmetric short fires when RSI(12) spikes above 80 below VWAP as momentum exhaustion invites sell-side VWAP programs to press the move.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute RSI drops below 20 above session VWAP, attracting VWAP-benchmarked buy flow to absorb the micro-selloff

name: rsi_connors_pullback_v54
mechanism: On BANKNIFTY, banking-sector institutional order flow executes in 90-120 second directional bursts driven by TWAP/VWAP algos rebalancing large banking equity and futures baskets. Within each burst, there are systematic 20-30 second micro-pauses — visible as RSI(6) (30-second RSI) retracing toward 45 while RSI(24) (2-minute RSI) still reflects the prevailing burst direction above 55. The original Strategy_110 logic (any dip when RSI(2) < 50 above SMA(200)) translates here as: RSI(6) < 45 is the 'any dip' in BANKNIFTY's fast cycle, while RSI(24) > 55 confirms the 2-min burst momentum is intact. Unlike prior variants using SMA or VWAP price-level filters, this dual-RSI approach is purely momentum-state driven — exploiting BANKNIFTY's higher beta (1.3-1.5x NIFTY) which produces more distinguishable RSI oscillations at 30-second resolution, enabling re-entry into the burst within 15-45 seconds of the micro-pause.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-second RSI dips below 45 while 2-minute RSI stays above 55, detecting a micro-pause within an active BANKNIFTY TWAP burst

name: rsi_divergence_vwap_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP selling programs execute in size bursts separated by absorption pauses: the index makes a new 1-minute low yet RSI (measuring momentum velocity, not price) fails to confirm because resting buy orders at each lower tick partially absorb the selling. This momentum-price divergence signals that the marginal seller is nearly exhausted. When NIFTY is also within 0.15% below session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms — which receive adverse fills below their benchmark — begin accelerating accumulation, creating a 30-90 second demand surge that reverts price toward VWAP. The entry fires at the moment the divergence is detectable (2-minute window comparison) while the demand response is just beginning.
core_signal_oneliner: Price makes a lower low over 2 minutes but RSI makes a higher low, signaling seller exhaustion while price is just below VWAP

name: rsi_extreme_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, sharp 2-minute directional bursts that push RSI_24 below 20 or above 80 represent concentrated retail stop-loss and momentum-chasing flow overshooting session VWAP. The moment RSI crosses back across the extreme threshold, the directional flush is exhausting — resting institutional limit orders positioned better than VWAP absorb remaining flow and drive a 10-20 spot point reversion over the next 30-90 seconds. Index-level reversion is faster and more reliable than single-stock reversion because NIFTY/BANKNIFTY are continuously arbitraged by futures participants who immediately fade deviations from VWAP-derived fair value, making the recovery self-reinforcing.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute RSI crosses back above 20 (or below 80) after reaching an extreme, with price still displaced from VWAP and elevated volume confirming the flush

name: rsi_reversal_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp 2-minute directional moves push RSI(24) into extreme territory (<30 or >70) as stop-loss cascades or momentum-chasing algos overshoot fair value. When this exhaustion occurs while the index is displaced from its 30-minute EMA — meaning price has deviated from where VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms are anchored — market makers absorb the terminal flow and resting limit orders accumulate. Within 30-90 seconds, the overshoot reverses as VWAP-tracking algorithms and gamma-hedging desks push the index back toward the 30-minute mean, creating a 10-20 spot point bounce (or fade) that option buyers can capture at ATM delta ~0.5.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute RSI below 30 (or above 70) while price is displaced below (or above) the 30-min EMA, signaling overshoot reversal back toward the intraday mean

name: sma_crossover_banknifty_v1
mechanism: On BANKNIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working directional orders create persistent micro-trends visible as SMA alignment across 3-min, 15-min, and 60-min windows. When SMA(36) > SMA(180) > SMA(720) all align bullishly AND price retouches the fast SMA(36) after a brief pullback, the order flow is sustained at multiple timescales — not just a spike but continuous demand absorption by institutional desks still working their orders. This micro-pullback-to-fast-SMA entry captures the next 30-50 spot point continuation leg while limiting exposure by entering during a retracement rather than chasing breakouts.
core_signal_oneliner: Three-timeframe SMA stack (3/15/60-min) fully bullish with price pulling back to the 3-min SMA, detecting sustained multi-scale institutional trend

name: smart_beta_intraday_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday consolidation phases compress the Keltner Channel (EMA ± 1.5×ATR) as institutional algorithms pause their directional orders to rebalance or wait for a catalyst. When ATR drops to the bottom 30th percentile of its 10-minute rolling window, the index is in a coiling state where both buy and sell resting liquidity is thin. A breakout above the upper band with simultaneous range expansion (current bar range > 1.5× 5-min average) signals that institutional demand has overwhelmed the supply ceiling — these breakouts have 30-90 second momentum continuation because the underlying directional orders are typically only partially filled and the algo continues buying. Unlike individual stocks, NIFTY breakouts from Keltner compression are cleaner because index movements aggregate multiple institutional flows rather than single-name events.
core_signal_oneliner: Keltner Channel breakout with prior ATR compression (bottom 30th percentile) and range expansion on the breakout bar, signaling post-coil institutional flow

name: spectral_analysis_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional participants executing TWAP/VWAP orders slice their inventory into fixed time-based tranches (typically 30-90 seconds each), and option market makers continuously delta-hedge by periodically buying or selling the index in rhythmic bursts. These execution patterns create measurable periodic micro-oscillations in NIFTY's 5-second price series at cycle lengths of 30-180 seconds. When the FFT of the last 20 minutes of 5-second closes reveals a dominant spectral peak at a 30-180 second period with power exceeding 3.5x the spectral noise floor — and that dominant period has been stable for the past 30 seconds — the institution-driven cycle is significant and exploitable. We enter at confirmed phase extrema: at cycle troughs (phase ≈ π, cosine minimum) with a 10-second positive ROC confirmation for CE, and at cycle peaks (phase ≈ 0, cosine maximum) with negative ROC for PE.
core_signal_oneliner: FFT of 20-min 5s price series reveals a dominant 30-180s cycle with SNR > 3.5 and price at phase extremum (trough for CE, peak for PE)

name: spread_dynamics_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second bar's high-low range expands to 2× or more the 5-minute rolling average range, it signals a liquidity stress event — typically a stop-cascade execution, large institutional TWAP block completing, or aggressive momentum algo entry overwhelming resting orders. NIFTY's continuous futures depth means these stress bursts complete within 30-60 seconds and leave a directional overshoot as the aggressive initiator finishes, with resting limit orders on the other side temporarily absorbed. When the per-bar range contracts back below 1.5× normal (stress resolved), NIFTY futures market makers who widened their quotes and delta-hedged during the event begin rebalancing inventory, and VWAP-benchmarked algorithms resume passive fills at their benchmark prices — this systematic reversal flow drives a 40-60% reversion of the spike move within the next 60 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Bar range expands to 2x the 5-min average then contracts below 1.5x, signaling liquidity stress resolution and fading the directional overshoot

name: squeeze_release_breakout_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, when Bollinger Bands (2-minute window) compress inside Keltner Channels, institutional algorithms have temporarily suspended directional activity and resting limit orders are stacked symmetrically around a tight range. This equilibrium accumulates directional pressure. When price breaks above the 24-bar rolling high with 90-second and 3-minute EMAs both aligned bullishly and above-average volume participation, algorithmic TWAP/VWAP flow initiates a new directional wave, typically carrying NIFTY 15-25 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds before the next equilibrium forms. The volume surge confirms that institutional orders are actively absorbing supply (or demand) rather than a random spike through the compression range.
core_signal_oneliner: Bollinger Bands compress inside Keltner Channels and price breaks the 2-min range with EMA alignment and volume expansion, releasing the accumulated directional pressure

name: stochastic_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index sells off sharply enough within a 70-second window to push the stochastic below 20, it reflects that aggressive order flow has briefly overwhelmed the available bid-side liquidity at that depth. The moment %K crosses above %D from the oversold zone, it marks the first measurable slowdown in the rate of decline — resting limit buy orders and institutional delta hedges begin absorbing the selling pressure. This creates a micro-reversion of 10-20 NIFTY spot points over the subsequent 30-90 seconds, captured by entering ATM calls on the cross bar. The inverse holds symmetrically for overbought crosses: supply absorbs demand at the short-term range top and the index fades 10-20 spot pts.
core_signal_oneliner: Stochastic %K crosses above %D from below the 20 oversold level within VWAP proximity, marking 70-second selling exhaustion

name: straddle_proxy_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, after the first 45 minutes absorb overnight information, the index frequently consolidates near the previous day's close — a critical reference level monitored by every institutional VWAP desk, passive fund, and algorithmic market-maker as a benchmark anchor. When NIFTY's 5-minute ATR compresses below 75% of its 20-minute average AND Bollinger Band width falls into its lowest 20th percentile of the past 20 minutes, the order book is in equilibrium and neither side has conviction. This coiled state precedes sharp directional moves: once price crosses the PDC ± 0.5×ATR(5min) trigger band, clustered stop-loss orders above/below the pivot activate, index options gamma-hedging desks amplify the impulse, and NIFTY can travel 10-20 spot points within 30-60 seconds — sufficient to capture 5-8 option premium points on a correctly-timed CE (upside break) or PE (downside break) entry.
core_signal_oneliner: ATR compresses below 75% of its 20-min average near the previous day's close pivot and price breaks the PDC ± 0.5×ATR band, triggering stop-cascade and gamma-hedging impulse

name: supertrend_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 2-minute SuperTrend (ATR period=24 bars at 5s, multiplier=3.0) defines a dynamic ATR-based support/resistance channel. When NIFTY price pierces this channel and SuperTrend flips direction, algorithmic strategies — especially those deployed by retail traders on Zerodha Kite where SuperTrend(10, 3.0) is the platform default indicator — detect the same signal and cascade directional market orders. Since NIFTY futures and options are India's most heavily algo-traded instruments, a SuperTrend flip aligned with VWAP (confirming macro session direction) triggers a self-reinforcing 15-60 second momentum burst as momentum algos pile in before the burst exhausts. We enter at the first 5-second confirmation bar and exit within 90 seconds before mean reversion begins.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-min SuperTrend flips direction with VWAP alignment and above-average volume, triggering a cascade of retail and institutional algo orders

name: support_resistance_reversal_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's previous day high and low are the most-watched reference levels by all algorithmic market makers, institutional desks, and retail momentum traders simultaneously — making them genuine order-flow anchors, not arbitrary lines. When NIFTY probes the previous day's high, option writers (covered call desks, prop short-gamma positions) and fresh put buyers cluster limit orders within 15-25 spot points of that level, creating a dense supply wall that materialises as range contraction at 5-second resolution. At 5s granularity, we detect the micro-structural 'probe-and-reject' signature: price approaching within 0.15% of the prev day level, range contracting over the last 30 seconds (accumulation of resting limit orders), and a visible 15-second rejection move in the opposite direction — all before the full 1-minute bar closes. BANKNIFTY amplifies this effect due to 2-3x higher volatility, so the same proximity threshold generates larger option moves.
core_signal_oneliner: Price within 0.15% of previous day high/low with range contracting over 30s and a 15s rejection print, detecting probe-and-reject at key daily S/R

name: three_bar_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when three consecutive 5-second bars each close in the same direction (close > open for bulls) with both volume and bar range expanding monotonically, it indicates an institutional TWAP or algo order is still actively routing — each successive 5-second slice consumes more liquidity at a wider spread than the previous, signaling the order has not yet completed its fill. Unlike individual FnO stocks where this pattern can reflect a single large order, NIFTY's index composition means three expanding-volume bullish bars reflect aggregate buy-side imbalance from multiple participants simultaneously, making continuation more persistent. The next 15-90 seconds captures the residual 'still-filling' phase before the algorithmic slice completes and the imbalance normalizes.
core_signal_oneliner: Three consecutive 5s bars in the same direction with monotonically expanding volume and range, signaling an active TWAP order still routing

name: tick_direction_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, institutional TWAP and momentum algorithms execute directional orders over multiple 5-second bars, imprinting a persistent bias in bar-by-bar close direction. When >62% of the last 3 minutes of 5-second bars close higher (tick_dir_ratio > 0.62) and this ratio is accelerating, large buy-side flow is continuously absorbing sell-side liquidity — market makers short gamma via ATM options must delta-hedge by buying the index in the same direction, compounding the upward pressure. We enter 30-60 seconds into this dominance phase, before the signal becomes visible on 1-minute charts, and ride the institutional order completion window (30-90 seconds). The converse applies for persistent downtick dominance signaling sell-side absorption.
core_signal_oneliner: Over 62% of 3-min 5s bars close up (tick direction dominance) and this ratio is accelerating, with VWAP alignment confirming institutional buy-side pressure

name: trade_arrival_rate_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP and VWAP programs working large directional orders create sharp volume bursts that are 2-3x above the expected activity for that minute of the day. NIFTY's intraday volume follows a well-known U-shape (elevated at open and close, suppressed at midday), so a raw volume spike at 10:30 IST is far more anomalous than the same absolute volume at 09:20 IST — only spikes normalized against the time-of-day baseline reveal genuine institutional order flow. When such a normalized volume burst coincides with directional price impact (the burst window closes significantly above or below its open) and the index is already positioned above/below session VWAP, the institutional order is only partially filled and will continue pushing prices over the next 30-90 seconds. If the burst shows no net directional impact, it signals passive market-making churn and is ignored.
core_signal_oneliner: 15-second volume exceeds 2x the time-of-day expected baseline with directional price impact and VWAP alignment, signaling an active institutional burst order

name: trend_counter_trend_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute Supertrend flips bullish (bearish) while price is above (below) session VWAP and the 5-minute EMA trend aligns, it signals that institutional directional algorithms have committed to a short-term trend — their TWAP/VWAP execution orders are now directionally biased and will sustain the move for the next 30-90 seconds. The counter-trend sell signal fires when 3-minute RSI diverges from price (new spot high but RSI lower) AND NIFTY has overshot VWAP by 15+ spot points — at that level, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms begin systematic fade-selling against the benchmark, providing an asymmetric early exit before trend exhaustion.
core_signal_oneliner: Supertrend flip aligned with VWAP and EMA trend, with RSI-divergence counter-trend exit at VWAP overshoot

name: trend_strength_adaptive_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the strength of an intraday trend (measured by 3-minute ADX) determines how fast directional momentum can be captured: high-ADX regimes (ADX > 35) reflect concentrated institutional order flow where even a 30-second window is sufficient to confirm direction, while low-ADX regimes (ADX 18-25) require 2-3 minutes of EMA history to filter noise. The adaptive EMA crossover exploits this by contracting its lookback from ~36 bars (3 min) to ~12 bars (1 min) as ADX rises, making the signal faster precisely when fast signals are reliable. The +DI/-DI comparison on 3-minute bars confirms that directional pressure is asymmetric — not just overall volatility — while the VWAP filter ensures the trade aligns with the accumulated session-level institutional flow benchmarking on NIFTY.
core_signal_oneliner: ADX-adaptive EMA crossover where lookback contracts as trend strength rises, confirmed by DI asymmetry and VWAP alignment

name: vix_adjusted_mean_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms (pension funds, FIIs executing large program orders) aggressively fade intraday deviations from session VWAP, but their activation threshold scales with current VIX. In low-VIX regimes (< 14), NIFTY's compressed realized vol makes even a 20-30 spot point deviation from VWAP statistically anomalous (z-score ~1.0), triggering immediate algo-driven fading within 30-60 seconds. In high-VIX regimes (> 20), those same institutions require 60-80 spot point deviations (z-score ~2.5+) before fading because intraday noise is genuinely wider and smaller deviations are not statistically significant. By scaling the entry z-score threshold dynamically with VIX — entering only when the deviation is anomalous relative to the current volatility regime — we isolate the conditions where the reverting institutional force is strong enough to produce a measurable 30-90 second bounce on the index.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score deviation fade where the entry threshold scales dynamically with current India VIX level

name: vix_bucket_strategy_v1
mechanism: India VIX is constructed from NIFTY option implied volatilities and reflects institutional hedging demand in real time. In Calm regimes (VIX < 13), NIFTY's tight intraday range means market makers aggressively fade 3-minute Bollinger Band excursions — they are collecting spread in low-vol, and any 10-15 spot point deviation from VWAP is absorbed within 30-60 seconds. In Normal regimes (VIX 13-18), large TWAP algorithms run directional orders lasting minutes; an EMA(9-min) crossing above EMA(21-min) on NIFTY signals a fresh wave of institutional buying that typically sustains for 45-90 seconds. In Elevated regimes (VIX 18-24), delta-hedging by options dealers creates self-reinforcing momentum: dealers short gamma who hedge must buy rising and sell falling NIFTY, extending Supertrend-confirmed directional moves for 60-120 seconds. Crisis regimes (VIX > 24) are excluded.
core_signal_oneliner: Three-regime VIX bucket strategy: BB mean-reversion in Calm, EMA crossover in Normal, Supertrend momentum in Elevated

name: vix_filtered_index_trend_v124
mechanism: When India VIX spikes above 21, NIFTY's intraday order flow shifts from retail-dominated mean-reverting noise to sustained institutional directional flow — FIIs either aggressively de-risking or accumulating in bulk. In this regime, the 60-second EMA crossing above the 5-minute EMA on NIFTY signals the onset of one of these institutional waves, confirmed by price trading above session VWAP (day's dominant direction). At 5-second resolution, we enter at the first crossover bar rather than waiting for a full 1-minute confirmation, capturing 20-40% more of the initial impulse before algorithmic followers pile in. The VIX ceiling at 35 avoids extreme panic conditions where NIFTY gaps erratically and limit-order fills become unreliable.

The microstructure signature of impending market-maker hedge flow is a 30-second bar range contraction (the selling wave exhausts: the 6-bar high-low range shrinks relative to the prior 2-minute range) combined with the close near the top of that compressed range (buyers absorbing the last sellers). We enter at the first 5-second bar showing this basing pattern while the VWAP deviation is in the moderate zone, entering faster than v18's dev_momentum approach which waits a full 2 minutes for zscore improvement to confirm.
core_signal_oneliner: Moderate VWAP z-score dislocation (-1.4 to -2.0) with 30-second range contraction and close near top of compressed range (basing microstructure)

name: vwap_mean_reversion_v3
mechanism: On NIFTY, z-score deviations beyond ±2.7 from session VWAP occur roughly once per session and represent capitulation events — retail margin calls and stop-loss cascades push the index 80-120 spot points below VWAP, accompanied by a visible volume surge as forced sellers hit the bid. At this extreme three distinct buyer types converge simultaneously: VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms crossing their urgency threshold, options dealers short puts who must buy delta as gamma accelerates, and stat-arb desks exploiting index mispricing vs. component futures. The snap-back is sharp (20-40 spot points in 30-90 seconds) because supply thin out immediately after the panic flush. The volume surge confirmation distinguishes genuine capitulation from slow directional drift that can continue.
core_signal_oneliner: Extreme VWAP z-score (±2.7 sigma) with panic-level volume surge (1.7x 2-minute baseline), targeting multi-buyer convergence capitulation snap-back

name: vwap_mean_reversion_v5
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX exceeds 15, market maker quote widening and elevated institutional hedging urgency amplify intraday moves — even moderate-volume directional selling (1.2x the 4-minute baseline, not panic levels) can drive NIFTY 80-100 spot points below session VWAP within minutes, creating a z-score below -2.7 on the 20-minute rolling standard deviation. In elevated-VIX regimes, VWAP-benchmarked buy-side algorithms increase their accumulation urgency threshold precisely because the cost of underperforming their benchmark compounds faster when volatility is high — they step in aggressively once deviation reaches the 2.7-sigma level to ensure VWAP-or-better fills before further vol expansion makes it impossible. This differs from low-VIX VWAP reversion (v1, v18) where deviations are shallower and slower, and from panic capitulation (v3) where 1.7x volume is required regardless of VIX regime — here the VIX filter does the selectivity work, allowing a lower volume bar (1.2x) to be the confirmation trigger.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score below -2.7 sigma in elevated-VIX sessions (VIX > 15), with low volume bar requirement (1.2x) made reliable by regime gate

name: vwap_overshoot_fade_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drifts 0.3%+ below (or above) session VWAP in a low-ADX tape, the move is driven by algorithmic momentum triggers and retail chase flow — not institutional directional conviction. RSI(24) (a 2-minute exhaustion read at 5s bars) hitting below 15 or above 85 signals that micro-momentum is fully spent and no new sellers/buyers are stepping in. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks then begin rebalancing aggressively — fills at 0.3% from VWAP give them significant benchmark outperformance, creating strong buy/sell pressure back toward VWAP. The low ADX(36) filter (3-minute trend strength < 22) ensures no large TWAP/VWAP execution is underway, which would override the reversion tendency.
core_signal_oneliner: 0.3% VWAP deviation with 2-minute RSI at extreme exhaustion (<15/>85) in a low-ADX range-bound early session tape

name: vwap_overshoot_fade_002
mechanism: On NIFTY, a 0.6%+ deviation from session VWAP (~135 spot points at 22500) crosses a threshold that activates two structural reversion forces absent at shallower levels: options market makers who accumulated long delta exposure from selling calls/puts during the move begin systematic gamma-hedging rebalances — their risk models flag 0.6%+ index deviations as outliers requiring immediate adjustment. Simultaneously, risk-parity and VWAP-indexed institutional programs that tolerate minor (0.3%) misalignments hit their rebalancing band and begin aggressive accumulation, creating sustained demand/supply flow back toward VWAP. The Bollinger band filter (20-minute ±2σ envelope, 240 bars at 5s) ensures the index has NOT broken out of its intraday stochastic range — price inside the envelope means the overshoot is likely a transient inventory imbalance, not a regime change. RSI(36) exhaustion below 20 (3-minute window, matching original RSI(3) on 1-min) confirms the 5-second directional momentum driving the overshoot has fully burned out before structural buyers arrive.
core_signal_oneliner: Deep 0.6% VWAP deviation with 3-minute RSI extreme exhaustion (<20/>80), ADX range-bound, and inside 20-minute Bollinger band (not a breakout)

name: vwap_overshoot_fade_003
mechanism: On NIFTY, in moderate-VIX sessions (12-24), a 0.5% deviation from session VWAP is caused by structured retail stop-sweeps and short-horizon algo momentum triggers — not by institutional directional conviction (which would elevate VIX above 24) or by benign drift in dormant tapes (VIX below 12 where deviations are shallow and listless). When RSI(60) — a 5-minute exhaustion signal — reaches below 22 or above 78, the directional momentum engine has operated at maximum intensity for 5 full minutes without continuation: the triggering algos have exhausted their order queue. A green close bar (close > open) on the down-overshoot confirms that 5-second micro-momentum has already pivoted bullish before entry, rather than anticipating the turn — NIFTY's tight bid-ask and deep order book means a single pivot bar on the index reliably marks the order imbalance flip.
core_signal_oneliner: 0.5% VWAP deviation with 5-minute RSI at extreme (<22/>78) in moderate VIX (12-24) regime, confirmed by bullish/bearish pivot bar

name: vwap_pinch_breakout
mechanism: On NIFTY, the session VWAP anchors institutional execution benchmarks while a 2-minute EMA tracks short-term directional drift. When these two anchors converge to within 0.05% of spot, NIFTY is in micro-equilibrium: VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (both buy-side and sell-side) are filling at similar prices and neither directional camp holds an advantage. When price breaks above BOTH anchors simultaneously with a volume surge, it signals that buy-side institutional order flow has overwhelmed the balance — their accumulated unfilled demand drives a 10-20 spot point continuation as sell-side algorithms step back and liquidity thins. The reverse applies on breaks below both anchors: trapped long positions and fresh sell flow compound into a quick downside continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: Simultaneous breakout above EMA(24) and session VWAP when both are within 0.05% of each other (micro-equilibrium pinch), confirmed by volume surge

name: vwap_pivot_rejection_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the session VWAP drifts within 25 spot points of a daily pivot level (S1, PP, or R1 computed from previous day's H/L/C), two independent algorithmic order clusters concentrate at the same price region — VWAP-benchmarked futures algorithms defending their average fill cost and pivot-level conditional order queues (stop-clusters and entry triggers built around round-number pivot math). A 30-second price test into this double-friction zone followed by a dominant directional wick (close ending in the opposite direction from the test, 55%+ of 30s range as the rejection wick) signals institutional absorption held: both VWAP defenders and pivot algo buyers/sellers absorbed supply/demand and the zone validated. The next 45-90 seconds typically see 15-25 NIFTY spot points of follow-through as momentum algorithms confirm the zone defended and pile in.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP within 25 points of daily pivot (S1/PP/R1) with 30-second rejection wick dominant in opposite direction (55%+ of range), confirming double-friction zone defense

name: vwap_reclaim_trend_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index has been trading below session VWAP for most of a 3-minute window, every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm is accumulating passively at better-than-benchmark prices. The moment price reclaims VWAP with the 3-minute EMA crossing back above the 15-minute EMA, those accumulated long positions shift from passive absorption to active continuation — algo systems now need to fill the remainder of their order at or above VWAP, creating a 20-35 spot point continuation burst over the next 30-90 seconds. The bearish mirror applies when sustained above-VWAP drift reverses through VWAP with EMA structure turning negative, as benchmark algos unwind longs and delta-hedging flows accelerate the move.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY below VWAP 75%+ of last 3 minutes, then price crosses back above VWAP with 3-min EMA above 15-min EMA (trend-aligned reclaim)

name: vwap_rsi_confluence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index trades >0.3% below session VWAP while the 2-minute RSI (24 bars at 5s) falls below 30, two distinct institutional flows converge simultaneously: VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (pension funds, FII desks) begin aggressive accumulation because they are filling 30-50 points below their daily benchmark, and delta-hedging market makers who sold ATM puts at the RSI extreme begin unwinding their short delta. This dual-flow demand creates sharp 15-40 second reversions of 10-20 NIFTY spot points. The RSI slope turning positive from below 30 (within the same 5-second bar) signals the exhaustion of selling pressure before the 1-minute bar closes, enabling entry 45-55 seconds earlier than the original strategy's 1-min confirmation — capturing the steepest part of the reversion curve.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP deviation >0.3% with 2-minute RSI below 30 and RSI slope turning positive, plus bullish candle bar confirmation

name: vwap_rsi_volume_confluence_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY drops sharply below its session VWAP (z-score < -1.5 by rolling 20-minute stddev) while the 2-minute RSI falls below 25 AND index volume spikes 2x+ the 20-minute average, it signals a climax selloff from stop cascades or algorithmic de-risking that has overshot fair value. VWAP-benchmarked institutions — responsible for a large share of NIFTY intraday flow — become aggressive buyers when receiving fills well below their session benchmark, providing mechanical buy-side pressure within 30-90 seconds. The volume surge is critical: it distinguishes institutional participation (stop-cascade climax) from thin-market drift below VWAP, making the reversion higher-probability than z-score or RSI alone. All three conditions firing simultaneously reduces false positives by filtering out slow drifts (high z-score, low volume) and noise spikes (high volume, z-score not extreme).
core_signal_oneliner: Triple-confluence: VWAP z-score below -1.5 sigma AND 2-minute RSI below 25 AND volume 2x the 20-minute average (climax selloff identification)

name: vwap_rsi_volume_hybrid_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drops 20+ spot points below session VWAP with RSI(36) reading below 35 (3-minute oversold exhaustion) and volume spiking 1.5x the 20-minute average, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buy programs activate aggressively — they are filling significantly better than their intraday benchmark and are incentivized to accumulate at these levels. The volume surge distinguishes a genuine panic flush (where resting bid orders absorb aggressive selling) from a slow drift away from VWAP; only the former creates a sharp mean-reversion snap. At 5-second resolution we enter on the first uptick confirming selling exhaustion, capturing the initial 10-20 spot point bounce before 1-minute bar participants can react — an entry timing advantage unavailable at coarser timeframes.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY 20+ spot points below VWAP with 3-minute RSI below 35 and volume 1.5x baseline, entry on first uptick (exhaustion confirmed)

name: vwap_slope_momentum_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's session VWAP sustains an elevated linear-regression slope (z-score > 1.5 persisting 25+ seconds), it reflects active institutional TWAP execution — large buy-side desks slicing directional orders into the NIFTY futures book, weighted by volume. NIFTY futures market makers continuously quote against VWAP benchmarks, so a persistently steep VWAP slope forces their delta-hedging in the same direction, amplifying the initial institutional push and creating short-term price momentum at the index level. The 5-bar persistence requirement (25 seconds at 5s bars) filters NIFTY's inherent single-candle noise and confirms the slope is institutionally sustained — we enter as that flow continues and ride the 30-90 second continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP slope z-score above 1.5 sigma (vs 20-minute baseline) sustained for 5 consecutive bars (25 seconds), confirming active institutional TWAP execution in progress

name: vwap_slope_trend_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP and VWAP execution algorithms are benchmarked against session VWAP — when they need to buy, they systematically lift offers at progressively higher prices, causing the VWAP slope to rise. At 5-second resolution, the 3-minute VWAP slope (linreg over 36 bars) captures this institutional directional pressure before it fully manifests in price. When the 1-minute slope (12 bars) exceeds the 3-minute slope, it signals that institutional demand is accelerating, not plateauing — the executing TWAP order has not finished and the remaining flow will push NIFTY spot another 10-20 points in the same direction. This acceleration window is the entry trigger: buy CE when slope is positive and building, buy PE when slope is negative and deepening, holding for the next 60-90 seconds while institutional execution continues.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-minute VWAP slope positive and building (slope_12 > slope_36) with price above VWAP and above 3-minute EMA, signaling institutional TWAP acceleration

name: vwap_volume_divergence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drifts 1.5+ standard deviations below session VWAP while 5-second bar volumes are declining (price-volume exhaustion), the directional sell-flow is running out of fuel — retail stops and algo trigger cascades have completed their selling but large VWAP-benchmarked institutions have not yet accumulated enough. The divergence sharpens when OBV over the same 2-minute window is simultaneously rising (buyers absorbing inventory at depressed prices) even as the price is still below VWAP, signaling that net demand is recovering before spot prices visibly inflect. NIFTY then snaps back 8-15 spot points toward VWAP within 30-90 seconds as the algorithmic VWAP buyers push aggressively to close their benchmark gap. Symmetric logic applies for bearish divergence: price above VWAP with declining volume and falling OBV signals distribution exhaustion and downward reversion.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score below -1.5 sigma with declining volume (below 85% of 2-min SMA) but rising OBV — price-volume divergence signaling absorption before reversion

name: vwap_zscore_bounce_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's VWAP z-score crosses ±2.0 sigma, the index is at a statistically rare deviation from session VWAP — a level where TWAP/VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms (mutual fund block desks, FII VWAP execution) start getting significantly worse fills relative to their benchmark. This creates mechanical reversal pressure: at z < −2.0, TWAP buy orders accelerate (buying cheap vs. benchmark), injecting demand that arrests the selloff; at z > +2.0, TWAP sell orders accelerate, capping the rally. At 5-second resolution we detect the exact bar where z-score begins turning back from its extreme (zscore_delta3 sign flip), entering the reversion within the first 15 seconds rather than waiting for a full 1-minute confirmation bar on the original timeframe.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score at ±2.0 sigma (30-minute std) with 15-second z-score momentum turning back toward zero (zscore_delta3 sign flip)

name: vwap_zscore_mean_reversion
mechanism: On NIFTY, hundreds of concurrent institutional VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (mutual funds, FIIs, prop desks) compete to fill directional orders throughout the mid-session. When a large block or cascade of market orders temporarily drives NIFTY 2.5+ standard deviations away from session VWAP in a non-directional (low directional-efficiency) regime, these VWAP algos collectively accelerate in the opposite direction — each algo is getting fills significantly better than its VWAP benchmark and increases participation rate. The resulting institutional counter-flow produces a mean-reversion snap-back of 10-20 NIFTY spot points within 30-90 seconds. The ADX/directional-efficiency filter is critical: on trending days NIFTY can sustain 3-sigma VWAP deviations for hours, so we only trade when the session character is choppy (directional efficiency < 0.30).
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score at ±2.5 sigma in a low directional-efficiency regime (<0.30 over 5 minutes), with bullish/bearish pivot bar confirmation

name: wavelet_decomposition_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's 5-second price series has genuine multi-scale structure: sub-10s microstructure noise (order book flicker, partial fills), 20–80s directional bursts from institutional algo legs, and session-level drift. By applying a Haar wavelet level-3 approximation (equivalent to an 8-bar = 40s simple moving average), we separate the 'tradeable band' (20–80s cycles) from tick noise, producing a denoised trend line. When the raw NIFTY price crosses above this denoised line AND the denoised slope is rising, it means a momentum burst has emerged cleanly from noise — sustained institutional TWAP/VWAP order flow has pushed price above its own smoothed trend, signaling continuation over the next 30–90 seconds. Detail energy (std of raw-vs-denoised divergence) filters out choppy, flat markets where crossovers are meaningless noise events.
core_signal_oneliner: Raw price crosses above 40-second Haar-wavelet denoised trend (SMA-8) with rising denoised slope and active detail energy, filtered by bullish VWAP context

name: weighted_indicator_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the relative predictiveness of momentum vs. mean-reversion signals rotates across intraday sessions — EMA crossovers dominate trending mornings when institutional TWAP flows are active, while RSI thresholds predict better in choppy afternoon sessions when market makers are fading extremes. This strategy tracks each indicator's recent 50-signal hit rate and applies softmax performance weighting (temperature α=2.0), automatically concentrating composite weight on whichever signal type has been most predictive in the current regime. When the weighted composite of VWAP position, 2-min RSI, MACD histogram, EMA(18/42) crossover, and OBV-vs-SMA trend exceeds 0.55 with at least 3 of 5 indicators aligned directionally, NIFTY is exhibiting coordinated multi-timescale order flow that typically sustains a 12-18 spot point move over 60-90 seconds as the dominant algorithmic flow completes its execution cycle.
core_signal_oneliner: Softmax-weighted composite of 5 indicators (VWAP, RSI, MACD, EMA cross, OBV) exceeds 0.55 with at least 3 of 5 aligned, weights updated by rolling 50-signal hit rate

name: williams_r_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic momentum flows periodically push the index to the extreme of its 3-minute high-low range — Williams %R below -88 — accompanied by an elevated volume ratio, signaling a climax bar where aggressive sellers have cleared the near-side order book. At this point, passive buy orders resting below market begin absorbing remaining supply, and delta-neutral market makers short gamma (from ATM option selling) start hedging by buying NIFTY futures, creating a swift reversion toward mid-range. At 5-second resolution we capture the first 30-90 seconds of this rebound as Williams %R turns back from -90 toward -50, before the move dissipates into the session equilibrium. The VWAP proximity filter ensures we avoid entering during sustained institutional directional TWAP flows where the extreme can persist.
core_signal_oneliner: Williams %R(36) below -88 (3-minute range extreme) with 1.5x volume surge, VWAP proximity within 1.5%, and Williams %R slope already turning back over 15 seconds

name: zscore_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index price deviates more than 2 standard deviations from its 10-minute rolling mean, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms and intraday mean-reversion quants begin fading the move aggressively — they are getting fills 20-35 spot points away from recent equilibrium, which is statistically extreme at the 5-10 minute scale. The z-score velocity filter (30-second rate of change turning back toward zero) confirms the order flow rotation has begun before the full reversion impulse lands, allowing entry in the first 5 seconds of the bounce rather than waiting for a 1-minute bar confirmation. This is a pure price-level reversion signal: NIFTY's index construction (cap-weighted, 50 liquid large caps) means deviations from the 10-minute mean are quickly arbitraged by index futures market-makers keeping spot-futures basis tight.
core_signal_oneliner: Price z-score beyond ±2.0 sigma from 10-minute rolling mean with 30-second z-score velocity turning back toward zero (reversion onset confirmed)
